summary: Tonight I wrote my most important poem, one day I will have the confidence to share it with the world but not today, and that pains me, but shields from pricks of a sentence that punctuates a past running on and on #poetryport #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Tonight I wrote
my most important
poem, one day I will
have the confidence to
share it with the world
but not today, and that
pains me, but shields
from pricks of a sentence that
punctuates a
past running on and on
#poetryport
#smallpoems
